title: TopologySemanticContextBuildLimits
description: Safety and payload-shaping limits used when topology-service builds scoped semantic context for an active topology artifact.

maxSelections.description: Maximum number of available selection groups returned.

maxCatalogIdsPerSelection.description: Maximum catalog field ids returned inside one available selection group.

maxValueSummaryFields.description: Maximum number of catalog fields for which observed value summaries may be returned.

maxValuesPerField.description: Maximum number of observed values returned for one summarized catalog field.

maxStringValueBytes.description: Maximum UTF-8 byte length for one observed string value included in summaries.

valueSummariesMayTruncate.description: Whether topology-service may truncate observed value summaries to satisfy response limits.
